today.name: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
today.tagline: Turns website traffic into booked, qualified meetings
today.description: Your book-a-demo button converts 1-2% of visitors. The rest leave. Naoma replaces the form with an AI account executive that runs the demo right then: it walks the prospect through your live product, answers questions, qualifies them and books the meeting. It remembers returning visitors, picks up where they left off, and writes every session back to your CRM. 50,000+ demos run for B2B SaaS teams. Now self-serve: upload your product and knowledge base test the agent today.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunters 👋 Last time we launched Naoma here as an AI demo agent, and you made it #1 Product of the Day and #1 Product of the Month in Marketing. That launch is the reason everything below exists, so: thank you. Since then the agent has run 50,000 live demos on real B2B SaaS products - UXPressia, Hoteza, AiSDR and others - in 33 languages, at every hour of the day. Three things we didn't expect: 1. Nobody actually wanted more demos. They wanted fewer unqualified ones. The demo was never the bottleneck, the rep's calendar was. 2. Buyers come back, and restarting the demo from zero loses them. So the agent now recognizes returning visitors and asks where they want to pick up. 3. The conversion gap was bigger than we modeled. A "book a demo" button converts 1-2% of visitors. An agent that simply runs the demo converts 6-20%, depending on the product and the audience. So we stopped describing Naoma as a demo agent. Today we're launching it as an AI AE: it runs the demo on your live product, answers the pricing and edge-case questions, qualifies the buyer against your criteria, sends the big deals to your team and everyone else to self-serve, and writes the session back to your CRM. And the part that makes us nervous: it's self-serve now. Upload your product, build the agent yourself, have it live today - no call with us. That felt like the only honest option for a product whose entire argument is that you shouldn't have to book a call. One question, and I'll reply to every answer: if you put this on your site tomorrow, what's the one thing it would have to get right before you'd trust it in front of your buyers? Don't take our word for it - the agent on naoma.ai will demo Naoma to you.

today.aiReview:
مسئله و راه‌حل: فرم‌های درخواست دموی سنتی ریزش ۹۸ درصدی دارند. Naoma با ارائه یک ایجنت هوش مصنوعی زنده، تجربه نمایش زنده محصول، پاسخ به سوالات فنی و قیمت‌گذاری، و سنجش مشتری (Qualification) را در همان لحظه فراهم کرده و نرخ تبدیل را از ۱-۲٪ به ۶-۲۰٪ می‌رساند.

معماری و تکنولوژی: بهره‌گیری از مدل‌های زبانی بزرگ (LLM)، پردازش صوت و ویدیو آنلاین، تکنولوژی تشخیص کاربران بازگشتی، یکپارچه‌سازی دوطرفه با CRM (مثل HubSpot/Salesforce) و قابلیت خودسرویس (Self-Serve) برای ساخت ایجنت با آپلود پایگاه دانش.

مدل درآمدی: مدل اشتراک ابری (SaaS) بر اساس تعداد جلسات دمو، ایجنت‌های فعال و قابلیت‌های پیشرفته CRM.

نقاط قوت: کاهش خطای انسانی، پاسخگویی ۲۴/۷ به ۳۳ زبان، تبدیل فوری بازدیدکننده به لید ارزیابی‌شده، حذف جلسه هماهنگی با تیم فروش شرکت برای تست اولیه.

نقاط ضعف: نیاز به سطح بالای دقت مدل در پاسخ به سوالات پیچیده امنیتی/حقوقی و ریسک توهم مدل (Hallucination) هنگام نمایش زنده.

نکته طلایی برای ایران: تمرکز روی یکپارچه‌سازی این ابزار با نرم‌افزارهای CRM بومی (مانند دیدار، پیام‌گستر، دانا) و بهینه‌سازی صوت و متن فارسی برای سناریوهای فروش B۲B می‌تواند ارزش‌آفرینی فوق‌العاده‌ای در بازار SaaS ایران ایجاد کند.

today.aiReview:
مسأله و راه‌حل:
مدل‌های هوش مصنوعی به‌طور سنتی در دسترسی به داده‌های زنده و عمیق وب محدودیت دارند. Nimble با معرفی ایجنت‌های خودیادگیر، ابزاری ارائه داده که نه تنها وب را به صورت زنده خزش می‌کند، بلکه با هر بار اجرا، منابع معتبرتر را شناسایی کرده و کیفیت داده‌های ارسالی به هوش مصنوعی را به مرور زمان ارتقا می‌دهد.

معماری و تکنولوژی:
سیستم بر پایه ایجنت‌های خودکار و مکانیزم حافظه تکاملی (Compounding Reliability) طراحی شده است. استفاده از خط لوله‌های خزش زنده و الگوریتم‌های رتبه‌بندی مجدد منابع بر اساس تاریخچه اجراها، ساختاری بهینه برای کاهش هزینه‌ها و افزایش دقت ایجاد کرده است.

مدل درآمدی:
مدل درامد مبتنی بر مصرف اعتبار (Pay-as-you-go / Credits) است که به کاربران امکان کنترل دقیق بر روی منابع و میزان هزینه را می‌دهد.

نقاط قوت:
۱. داشتن حافظه از اجراهای قبلی و اولویت‌بندی هوشمند منابع.
۲. کنترل دقیق کاربر بر روی منابع ورودی و میزان مصرف اعتبار.
۳. قابلیت خزش عمیق و آنی.

نقاط ضعف:
۱. ابهام در میزان تاخیر (Latency) پاسخ‌دهی در پرس‌وجوهای پیچیده.
۲. وابستگی شدید کیفیت خروجی به ساختار منابع وب هدف.

نکته طلایی برای ایران:
در بازار ایران، بومی‌سازی این ابزار با تمرکز بر پایش قوانین و مقررات صامت یا تغییرات روزانه قیمت‌ها و اخبار در وب‌سایت‌های دولتی و خصوصی، همراه با مدیریت قطعی‌های اینترنت و تغییرات IP، می‌تواند ارزش افزوده فوق‌العاده‌ای برای سازمان‌ها و مجموعه‌های فین‌تک ایجاد کند.

today.description: Slashy is an AI-native email client for managing all your inboxes. Slashy Assistant is the AI built into it: it drafts replies in your voice, organizes email, schedules meetings, prepares briefings, and tracks follow-ups. Connect your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and favorite tools, and it starts helping within five minutes. Use it inside Slashy or through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. Set up automations in plain English, and Slashy proactively handles recurring work before you have to ask.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Harsha, co-founder/ceo of Slashy (can text me any questions at 262-271 5339). When we first launched Slashy, we asked why every AI email tool felt the same. They could all generate text, but they didn’t understand who you were talking to, what happened in your last meeting, what was stored in your CRM, or how you actually communicated. So we built an AI-native email client that could learn how you work and do email with you. But we kept running into another problem: a real assistant can’t be trapped inside your inbox. Your work is spread across multiple inboxes, your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and other tools. And you still need things done when you’re away from your desk. So today, we’re launching Slashy Assistant. Connect your tools, and within five minutes Slashy starts building the context it needs to help. It can draft replies in your voice, triage what matters, schedule meetings, prepare you for calls, track who owes you a reply, and find follow-ups that are about to slip. You can ask the assistant for help inside the Slashy email client, or reach the same assistant outside your inbox through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. It knows the same people, conversations, commitments, and preferences wherever you talk to it. And now Slashy doesn’t always have to wait for you to ask. Connect it to the tools you already use, then create automations in plain English: ✅ “Every morning, archive obvious spam and cold pitches, unsubscribe from repeat senders, and send me a summary.” ✅ “Before every meeting, combine my calendar, CRM, past emails, and meeting notes into a briefing.” ✅ “After every customer call, use the meeting notes to draft a follow-up and update the contact in my CRM.” ✅ “Text me on iMessage when an important customer replies.” ✅ “Every Friday, find conversations that have gone quiet and draft follow-ups.” You can connect Slashy to your CRM, meeting notetaker, calendar, and other tools through integrations and MCP. Once an automation is created, it keeps running proactively in the background. Our goal is simple: build an assistant that already understands your work, notices what needs attention, and is reachable wherever you happen to be. 🎁 Product Hunt exclusive: new customers can use code PRODUCTHUNT to get their first month of Slashy free. We’ll be here all day answering every comment. I’d love to know: what’s the first email task you’d ask Slashy to automate? 👇

today.aiReview:
پلتفرم Slashy Assistant حل‌کننده یکی از بزرگ‌ترین چالش‌های بهره‌وری یعنی تراکم صندوق ورودی (Inbox Zero) است. در ادامه تحلیل ساختاریافته این محصول ارائه شده است:

۱. مسئله و راه‌حل:
بسیاری از ابزارهای ایمیل مبتنی بر هوش مصنوعی فاقد درک بافت کاری (Context) کاربر هستند. سلاشی با ساخت یک کلاینت بومی هوش مصنوعی و گسترش آن به خارج از اینباکس (از طریق اسلک، پیامک و تماس)، به کاربر اجازه می‌دهد تمام ارتباطات، CRM و تقویم خود را یکپارچه کند و کارهای تکراری را با زبان ساده اتوماتیک سازد.

۲. معماری و تکنولوژی:
سلاشی از معماری مبتنی بر ایجنت (Agentic Workflow) و پروتکل MCP برای اتصال به ابزارهای مختلف استفاده می‌کند. موتور RAG پیشرفته آن قادر به استخراج لحن شخصی کاربر و اطلاعات بافتی از جلسات و ایمیل‌های قبلی است. دسترسی چندکاناله (Multi-channel) آن را به یک ایجنت همه‌جاحاضر تبدیل کرده است.

۳. مدل درآمدی:
مدل درآمدی SaaS مبتنی بر اشتراک ماهانه است که احتمالا بر اساس حجم اتوماسیون‌ها و تعداد کانال‌های متصل دسته‌بندی می‌شود.

۴. نقاط قوت:
- یادگیری و بازآفرینی دقیق لحن نگارش کاربر (بر اساس بازخورد کاربران کوچ‌کرده از Superhuman).
- دسترسی به دستیار از طریق ابزارهای بیرونی مثل iMessage و اسلک.
- اتوماسیون پیش‌دستانه (Proactive) بدون نیاز به دستور مستقیم مداوم.

۵. نقاط ضعف:
- چالش‌های مربوط به حریم خصوصی و امنیت داده‌های حساس شرکت‌ها.
- وابستگی شدید به پایداری APIهای ابزارهای شخص ثالث.

۶. نکته طلایی برای ایران:
در بازار ایران، کلید پیروزی چنین محصولی، ادغام ایمیل با اتوماسیون‌های اداری ایرانی، پیام‌رسان‌های محبوب (تلگرام/بله) و پشتیبانی عالی از لحن اداری و تعارفی زبان فارسی است. ارائه نسخه On-Premise (نصب محلی) می‌تواند نگرانی سازمان‌های ایرانی را بابت امنیت داده‌ها کاملاً برطرف کند.

today.description: Oats is an AI meeting note-taking tool that is completely open, local, and free. Designed to not get in the way of your meetings, no bots, no subscription needed when running locally with on-device LLM. Available on both macOS and Windows. Enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessment, coaching, auto-tracking follow ups and more features via ariso.ai cloud backend.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt! 👋We think AI meeting notes have become useful enough to be a basic utility. And basic utilities should be free, open source, and private by default.That’s why we built Oats 🥣 -- a free, open-source AI meeting note taker for Mac & Windows.Why Oats?Most AI meeting tools require a bot to join your calls, send your conversations to the cloud, lock useful features behind a subscription, or use your data in ways that aren’t always obvious.We wanted a different option.Oats runs locally on your computer. It can record your meetings without a bot joining the call, then transcribe and summarize the conversation on-device, using local AI models.Your recordings stay local. And because Oats is open source, you can use it, audit it, modify it, or build on top of it.No meeting bot. No model training on your data. No data lock-in.What you can do with Oats:Record meetings without inviting a botTranscribe and summarize locallyKeep recordings on your own computerRun with on-device LLMsInspect and modify the source codeUse it completely freeFor those who want more, Oats can also connect to the Ariso cloud backend for enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessments, coaching, automatic follow-up tracking, and more.Even when you use our cloud features, we will never use your meeting data to train our models, including on the free plan.Oats is also our first step toward open-sourcing more of what we build at Ariso.So we’d love the Product Hunt community to put it through its paces. Tell us what’s missing. Break something. Open an issue. Build something weird on top of it. Or contribute directly. 🥣We’ll be here all day answering questions.— The Ariso Team

today.name: Elva
today.tagline: Goodbye, Postman. Your APIs have new consumers
today.description: Developers use your APIs. Now agents do too. Elva discovers APIs from code, lets you choose what each audience can use, and runs your MCP servers with auth and analytics. Track agent activity and review changes as your code evolves

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt, Ana here 👋Four years ago, I was fed up with Postman and wanted to replace it. I started with docs as a side project. That became Theneo. We got into YC, and today 20,000+ companies use it.Through Theneo, we’ve seen how messy API management gets. Now some of our customers get more API calls from agents than humans, while the way they manage those APIs has barely changed.That’s why we built Elva. We started with a few customers, and today we’re opening it up to everyone.You can connect your repo and Elva builds your API catalog, maps how it’s used, and checks AI readiness (fyi no spec required). From there, create contracts around actual use cases: choose the endpoints and fields a customer, partner, or agent needs. Publish to docs platforms like Theneo or Mintlify, mocks, or hosted MCP servers. When your code changes, review the updates or sync them automatically under your publishing rules.For MCP, we handle hosting and auth. You can test across models, see which tools are slow or failing, and collect feedback directly from agents when they get stuck.Would love for you to try it with your own repo. Does it cover how you actually manage your APIs? What are we missing?

This is super cool! I’m particularly interested in the “checks agent readiness” part - sounds like expanding into AX which is super critical. Curious what are the parameters that Elva uses to determine agent readiness?

Elva’s approach to API contracts and governance looks useful for agent-facing APIs. How do you handle versioning and backward compatibility when a code change would break an existing MCP tool or consumer contract?
That YouTube thumbnail with Kill Bill concept is genius!

The MCP part is what really stood out to me here. Making APIs easier for agents to discover and actually use is a very real problem. Elva looks like a solid step in that direction. Congrats Ana and team!

"more API calls from agents than humans" is a real shift and the per-audience access split (developer vs partner vs agent) makes sense as a response to it. the part I'd want to poke at before adopting this is scope creep - once an agent has an MCP server with real auth, what stops it from chaining calls in ways nobody explicitly scoped for, versus a human hitting endpoints one at a time in Postman?
Solid product. Is there a CLI for it? If so, how can I use it. Can't wait to integrate this into my current workflow.
Do you support agent keys for different agents, so you can see which agent did what?

today.faDescription: توسعه‌دهندگان از APIهای شما استفاده می‌کنند و اکنون هوش مصنوعی‌ها (Agentها) نیز همین کار را انجام می‌دهند. Elva با اسکن کد، APIهای شما را کشف می‌کند و به شما امکان می‌دهد مشخص کنید هر مخاطب (توسعه‌دهنده، شریک تجاری یا Agent) به چه بخش‌هایی دسترسی داشته باشد. این پلتفرم سرورهای MCP شما را با احراز هویت و تحلیل داده اجرا می‌کند تا فعالیت Agentها را ردیابی کنید. با تکامل کد، تغییرات را بررسی کرده و به صورت خودکار همگام‌سازی کنید تا یکپارچگی سیستم حفظ شود.

faComments.text: سلام به همه، من آنا هستم. چهار سال پیش از پست‌من خسته شده بودم و خواستم جایگزینی برای آن بسازم. با یک پروژه جانبی متمرکز بر مستندات شروع کردم که به Theneo تبدیل شد. ما وارد YC شدیم و امروز بیش از ۲۰,۰۰۰ شرکت از آن استفاده می‌کنند. از طریق Theneo دیدم که مدیریت APIها چقدر می‌تواند پیچیده و نامنظم باشد. اکنون برخی مشتریان ما بیشترین تعداد فراخوانی API را از سمت Agentها دریافت می‌کنند، در حالی که روش مدیریت آن‌ها تقریباً تغییر نکرده است. به همین دلیل Elva را ساختیم. با چند مشتری شروع کردیم و اکنون آن را برای همه باز می‌کنیم. می‌توانید ریپازیتوری خود را متصل کنید تا Elva کاتالوگ API شما را بسازد، نحوه استفاده از آن را نقشه‌برداری کند و آمادگی برای هوش مصنوعی را بررسی کند (بدون نیاز به فایل spec). از آنجا می‌توانید قراردادهایی بر اساس موارد استفاده واقعی ایجاد کنید: انتخاب Endpoints و فیلدهایی که مشتری، شریک یا Agent نیاز دارد. سپس آن‌ها را در پلتفرم‌های مستندات مانند Theneo یا Mintlify، Mockها یا سرورهای MCP میزبانی‌شده منتشر کنید. وقتی کد شما تغییر می‌کند، به روزرسانی‌ها را بررسی کنید یا آن‌ها را به صورت خودکار تحت قوانین انتشار همگام‌سازی کنید. برای MCP، ما میزبانی و احراز هویت را مدیریت می‌کنیم. می‌توانید بین مدل‌های مختلف تست کنید، ببینید کدام ابزارها کند یا خطادار هستند و بازخورد را مستقیماً از Agentها زمانی که گیر می‌کنند جمع‌آوری کنید. دوست دارم آن را با ریپازیتوری خودتان امتحان کنید. آیا این روش مدیریت فعلی APIهای شما را پوشش می‌دهد؟ چه چیزی را از قلم انداخته‌ایم؟

این فوق‌العاده خنک است! من به ویژه به بخش «بررسی آمادگی Agent» علاقه‌مندم - به نظر می‌رسد گسترش به سمت AX (دسترسی‌پذیری هوش مصنوعی) که بسیار حیاتی است. کنجکاو هستم بدانم Elva از چه پارامترهایی برای تعیین آمادگی Agent استفاده می‌کند؟

آن تامبنیل یوتیوب با مفهوم فیلم Kill Bill ناب است!

So I rebuilt v2 of my brain, made it more robust, better maintenance to keep it sharp and made it so anybody can sign up and work with their agents and share brains with the people they live or work with. The plain version: it's your Dropbox for agent knowledge. You set it and forget it, and now you have all your stuff where you want it. Every agent you use reads and writes to the same brain, and so do your teammates and theirs. Start a new chat and it can know everything you've worked on... and anything your collaborators worked on. It handles conflicts for you. Stage/promote and there's automatic resolution for writes so a bunch of agents can work at the same time (decisions are always logged so you know who did what and why). New thinking doesn't erase the old, it deprecates it and links to the newest thinking. Your brain is encrypted so your IP, research, sci-fi romance novel or notes are private and I never train on it. I'm not trying to sell the smart engineers who don't get why they wouldn't just use a git repo for this. There are hundreds of millions of people who run their work through AI and need a shared knowledge system, and I'm building for them... and some of those engineers who just can't be bothered to maintain another thing. ;) It's still early: the maintenance loop is in alpha, but I used OzBrain to build OzBrain... I've used it to create nearly 1k articles that document what I'm building, why, who for, how and everything else I learn along the way. I don't need to change the way you work... since we all find our own little grooves, the best way to see how OzBrain can help you do more with agents is to grab the prompt on the homepage and hand it to Claude / ChatGPT and ask your own agent. yesterday.description: Clipwise saves any web page to your Notion databases — the whole article, not half of it. No account, no login, no paywall. Fill in your database properties before saving, and it remembers your last one. Everything stays on your computer.

comments.text: Hi Product Hunt 👋 I'm a solo developer, and I built Clipwise because every Notion web clipper I tried wanted me to create an account and log in — and those logins kept breaking or syncing slowly, right when I just wanted to save something quickly. Clipwise takes that whole layer out. You connect it once with your own Notion integration (a single paste), and after that it just works. No account with me, no server, nothing leaves your computer except the page you choose to save — which goes straight to your own Notion. A few things I cared about: • It saves the whole article, not half of it — including code blocks and content some clippers miss. • You fill in your Notion properties (tags, status, source…) before saving, so the page lands finished instead of as an empty row. • It remembers your last database, so the second clip is basically one click. • If a page comes out empty, it tells you instead of silently saving nothing. It's completely free. I'd genuinely love your feedback — what's missing, what feels off, what you'd want next. I'm reading every comment today. Thanks for taking a look 🙏

The "if a page comes out empty, it tells you instead of silently saving nothing" detail is the kind of thing you only add after getting burned by the alternative. Just left a review - the single-paste Notion connection instead of a full OAuth account flow is a nice touch too.

yesterday.name: DemoTV

yesterday.description: DemoTV is a 24/7 channel of product demos, ranked by the people watching. Submit a short demo for free. Viewers watch head-to-head Channel Battles and back the product they'd actually try, and an Elo-style audience score decides who sits on Channels 1-3. Businesses can buy clearly labelled airtime: money buys exposure, completed views and clicks, never the ranking.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I kept hitting the same wall: every product has a slick demo video, and none of them tell you whether the thing is actually good. The polish belongs to the product, not a reviewer. DemoTV flips that. It's a 24/7 channel of product demos where the audience decides the ranking. You watch two demos head-to-head, pick the one you'd actually try, and an Elo score from thousands of those votes sets who sits on Channels 1-3. Submitting is free. Money can buy exposure - clearly labelled airtime, real views and clicks - but it can never buy a better rank. That line is the whole point. Would love feedback on the format itself: does "channel" work for demos the way "leaderboard" works for launches? And what would make you submit yours?
I love this website! Full of ideas and inspiration. Great work!

معماری و تکنولوژی: نیاز به یک زیرساخت پخش ویدیویی مقیاس‌پذیر، شبکه توزیع محتوا (CDN) قوی و موتور محاسباتی آنی برای به‌روزرسانی امتیازات Elo بر اساس رای‌های هم‌زمان کاربران دارد.

yesterday.name: GhostWriter by MyHandler
yesterday.tagline: Two taps and it's already written
yesterday.description: Every other AI writes what you tell it. Ghostwriter writes what you already know. Double-tap Left Ctrl in any text field, in any app, and the reply is there — drawn from the thread on screen, your calendar, your files and your past meetings, indexed in an encrypted vault on your PC. It won't double-book you, and it matches how you write to that person, down to the sign-off. Then it stops: it types into the box and never sends. Windows.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt 👋I'm Tery. I've been shipping software for 40 years, since a Tandy CoCo with 4K of RAM. In 1999 it annoyed me that Pocket PC shipped without Access, so I built one — abcDB stayed the #1 Pocket PC database for a decade, across 135 countries. Even the UN ran it.That was trick one. Very excited to present another 🚀MyHandler is a local-first AI for Windows — think OpenClaw, for the rest of us who don't have a Mac Mini in a closet. It indexes your screen, files, mail, dictations, calendar and meetings into an encrypted vault on your own drive. Not our servers.✍️ Ghostwriter is the feature I'd start with.If you've ever sat staring at a blinking cursor, this is for you.Double-tap Left Ctrl in any text field, in any app.It reads what's on screen and works out what you were about to write.You get a draft in your voice ... pulling from your calendar, files and past meetings.Where OpenClaw acts for you, Ghostwriter never sends. There's no send path in the product. You read it, you edit it, you hit send.🎉 Start free with 300 credits/month. No card. PRODUCTHUNT30 takes 30% off.Windows 10 and 11 → myhandler.ai/ghostwriter

مسئله و راه‌حل:
بسیاری از کاربران روزانه زمان زیادی را صرف پاسخ‌دهی به ایمیل‌ها، پیام‌ها و تنظیم جلسات می‌کنند. ابزارهای هوش مصنوعی موجود نیازمند پرامپت‌نویسی دقیق هستند و داده‌های کاربر را به سرورهای ابری ارسال می‌کنند که خطرات حریم خصوصی دارد. Ghostwriter با رویکرد Local-First این مشکل را حل کرده است؛ ابزار فوق تمام فایل‌ها، تقویم و متون صفحه را به‌صورت محلی اندیس‌گذاری کرده و تنها با دو بار فشردن کلید Ctrl، پیش‌نویس پاسخ را متناسب با لحن کاربر در همان کادر متن ایجاد می‌کند بدون اینکه پیام را به‌صورت خودکار ارسال کند.

معماری و تکنولوژی:
نرم‌افزار بر پایه معماری محلی (Local-first AI) روی ویندوز پیاده‌سازی شده است. از مکانیزم OCR و خوانش مستقیم متون صفحه نمایش (Screen Indexing)، پایگاه‌داده برداری محلی رمزنگاری‌شده برای متون و جلسات قبلی، و مدل‌های زبانی کم‌حجم قابل اجرا روی سیستم کاربر استفاده می‌کند.

مدل درآمدی:
مدل فری‌میوم (Freemium) بر پایه اعتبار؛ اعطای ۳۰۰ اعتبار رایگان در ماه و فروش اشتراک‌های ماهانه/سالانه برای استفاده نامحدود یا اعتبارات بیشتر.

نقاط قوت:
۱. تمرکز بسیار بالا بر حریم خصوصی (عدم ارسال داده به سرور خارج).
۲. تجربه کاربری فوق‌العاده ساده و بدون اصطکاک (فقط دو بار زدن کلید Ctrl).
۳. کنترل کامل کاربر (عدم ارسال خودکار و فقط ایجاد پیش‌نویس).
۴. سابقه و تجربه ۴۰ ساله بنیان‌گذار در توسعه نرم‌افزار.

نقاط ضعف:
۱. محدودیت فعلی پلتفرم به ویندوز و عدم پشتیبانی از مک‌او‌اس.
۲. وابستگی شدید به منابع سخت‌افزاری سیستم کاربر برای اجرای مدل‌های محلی.
۳. ابهام کاربران درباره میزان دسترسی ابزار به اطلاعات صفحه نمایش.

نکته طلایی برای بازار ایران:
در ایران به دلیل ریسک‌های امنیتی ابزارهای ابری و قطعی‌های احتمالی اینترنت، یک دستیار نگارش محلی (Local) که بتواند با پیام‌رسان‌های بومی و اتوماسیون‌های اداری ایرانی یکپارچه شود و زبان فارسی را با دقت بالا پشتیبانی کند، شانس بسیار بالایی برای نفوذ در بازار سازمان‌ها و کسب‌وکارهای ایرانی دارد.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt! I’m Gustav, one of the makers of Epilude. Epilude started as a way to write with my voice after I hurt my elbow. Today, we’re launching Notetaker. It's the next step in helping you spend less time typing and more time thinking. I’ve always found meetings slightly self-defeating: either I focus on the conversation and forget half of what was agreed, or I take detailed notes and miss the conversation happening in front of me. Existing AI notetakers solve that problem, but they all send your data to cloud providers such as Anthropic and OpenAI, where you risk your data becoming part of their training data. We wanted something more private. Notetaker transcribes and summarises your meetings all locally on your Mac using our in-house trained model EP-1. That way, none of your data leaves your Mac, and your notes remain yours. When the meeting ends, Epilude gives you a clean transcript, an editable summary, and action items with owners and due dates. It automatically adapts the notes to the kind of meeting you had, so a standup, sales call, and planning session don’t all come back in the same generic format. Every key point links back to the transcript, making it easy to check exactly what was said. Each meeting is also saved as a Markdown file in a folder on your Mac, so you can open it in Obsidian, paste it into Notion, export it as a PDF, or keep it wherever you already work. Epilude Notetaker records directly from your Mac, so no bot joins the call and there’s nothing to invite or connect. If your Mac can hear the meeting, Epilude can take the notes, whether you’re using Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Slack, or talking across a table. My favourite part is simply being more present. I can stop half-listening while trying to write everything down and trust that the decisions and follow-ups will still be there when the call ends. Epilude is Mac-only for now. We’d love to hear what you think. Try it on your next call and let us know what we missed! You can try it (as well as our completely local dictation) for free.

It feels like the good old days — app purchases are back, which is possible again thanks to local AI models.I have one question and one concern.Question: Can I hook my Claude Code up to the meeting transcripts to do more powerful meeting summarization? How would it work in practice? Is it a folder where Epilode stores the transcripts, or does it work some other way?Concern: The Pay Once option only includes one year (!) of app and model updates... does that mean I'll have to buy the app again every year? I mean, what if it stops working when the next macOS drops?

comments.text: Hey Product Hunters 👋 Last time we launched Naoma here as an AI demo agent, and you made it #1 Product of the Day and #1 Product of the Month in Marketing. That launch is the reason everything below exists, so: thank you. Since then the agent has run 50,000 live demos on real B2B SaaS products - UXPressia, Hoteza, AiSDR and others - in 33 languages, at every hour of the day. Three things we didn't expect: 1. Nobody actually wanted more demos. They wanted fewer unqualified ones. The demo was never the bottleneck, the rep's calendar was. 2. Buyers come back, and restarting the demo from zero loses them. So the agent now recognizes returning visitors and asks where they want to pick up. 3. The conversion gap was bigger than we modeled. A "book a demo" button converts 1-2% of visitors. An agent that simply runs the demo converts 6-20%, depending on the product and the audience. So we stopped describing Naoma as a demo agent. Today we're launching it as an AI AE: it runs the demo on your live product, answers the pricing and edge-case questions, qualifies the buyer against your criteria, sends the big deals to your team and everyone else to self-serve, and writes the session back to your CRM. And the part that makes us nervous: it's self-serve now. Upload your product, build the agent yourself, have it live today - no call with us. That felt like the only honest option for a product whose entire argument is that you shouldn't have to book a call. One question, and I'll reply to every answer: if you put this on your site tomorrow, what's the one thing it would have to get right before you'd trust it in front of your buyers? Don't take our word for it - the agent on naoma.ai will demo Naoma to you.

comments.text: Hi Product Hunt 👋 I'm Josh, founder of theloqua.ai.I've spent my whole career as a speech and LLM researcher — and honestly, no voice product ever did what I actually needed. So I know exactly where ASR and voice agents break.It got personal when carpal tunnel, TFCC, and an old ski injury turned long hours at the keyboard into real pain. I live at my desk, deep in conversation with LLMs all day, and typing simply couldn't keep up with how fast I think. I wanted to speak the way I think — not the way I type.Not a wrapperOld dictation was a cascade of small models — transcribing sounds but never understanding meaning, and one mis-heard word broke everything downstream. So our team — a group of research scientists who've spent years training and optimizing models — set out to build it properly. Loqua is not a wrapper. Instead of gluing everything to an LLM, we built one full omni model where your voice and your screen share the same context.That single choice is what makes Loqua different. When you Capture to Ask — point at a chart, an error, or a table on your screen and just ask by voice — it reads code and tables more reliably, holds context better, and runs noticeably faster than bolt-on tools, thanks to a multimodal tokenizer and codec we designed ourselves. And because we train the model in-house, we keep sharpening it to real product needs and your feedback, every week.Where we're headedVoice and vision are only step one, though. The real direction is agentic — Loqua doing things for you. Say "remind me to send the Q4 draft at 3pm, and FaceTime Sarah" — and it happens, without you digging through menus or breaking your train of thought. Those little app-hunting detours are exactly what wreck your focus; Loqua takes them off your hands by voice so you can stay in the zone. And that's just our first attempt — next we're going after longer, multi-step tasks you can hand off in a blink and a simple sentence.What you can do today✍️ Speak, get polished text in any app⚡ Capture to Ask — ask about anything on your screen🎯 Get things done by voice across your Mac🔊 Listen instead of read🌐 ~100 languages, on macOS & WindowsWho it's forIt clicks fastest for people who live at a keyboard and now spend much of the day talking to AI — developers, PMs, researchers. A developer speaks a change straight to their coding agent in Cursor or Claude Code. A PM turns a rough spoken thought into a clean Slack update. Someone points at a chart on screen and just asks. And honestly, whatever you do all day — if your thinking outruns your hands, Loqua is for you.AP, Yahoo Finance & PR Newswire just covered us: *"Voice-to-text was never enough. Meet voice that sees."*https://apnews.com/press-release...We also launched adn ranked 1st in Uneed last week.https://www.uneed.best/weekly?da...Your keyboard isn't going away — you'll just need it less.🎁 Product Hunt Special — Stack your Pro days: 1. 30-day Pro trial — exclusive for PH users, find it in Promo code!2. 14-day welcome trial — for every new user, automatically3. +7 days each — share your code with a friend, you both get 7 extra days, no limitWe're especially trying to figure out which workflows people most want to make voice-native. Full disclosure — I'm a big fan of Anthropic and actually built an app that works exclusively with Claude Desktop for secure local file search. So I've spent a lot of time thinking about this space.My concern with Cowork isn't the vision, it's the architecture. Agentic tasks burn through tokens fast (Anthropic says so themselves), so that $200/month cap can disappear quicker than you'd expect. And at that price, you'd want to use it for real work — but the whole thing requires giving Claude direct read/write/delete access to your files. If you're handling client data, patient records, or anything regulated, you're basically out.The bigger issue is prompt injection. Anthropic admits "the chances of an attack are still non-zero" — and back in October 2025, researchers showed exactly that: a prompt injection against Claude that pulled up to 30MB of user data per request through Anthropic's own API. When you're talking about an agent with file system access, email connectors, and a browser, that's not some theoretical edge case.There's a reason some of us build tools where Claude can search your files without actually touching them. The agentic future is definitely coming, but "AI that can access everything" and "AI that keeps you in control" are two very different products for two very different users.

comments.text: Hey Product Hunt 👋 Joel here, one of the two Swedish founders building Goldfish.Why we built it:We started building Goldfish because AI still has one weird problem: it knows the internet, but not the work sitting right in front of you. AI has memory like a goldfish!Your messages, docs, tabs, meetings, half-written drafts, people, decisions, and loose threads already live on your computer. But every time you open a chatbot, you start from zero again. You paste the thread, explain the project, describe the person, and try to make it sound like you.That felt backwards to us.What Goldfish is:Goldfish is a private AI memory layer for your Mac. It understands what you’re working on across apps, then lets you use that context anywhere you type.Press ⌥ Option in any text field and Goldfish can help you:write replies in your own tone, with the thread and relationship context already theresummarize messy work from Slack, Gmail, docs, tabs, or meetingsrecall things you saw, wrote, read, or discussedrewrite highlighted text without touching the restbring your full computer context into Claude Desktop through our local MCP serverWhat we believe:The best AI product won’t be another empty chat box.It will be the memory layer underneath your work. Something that understands your context privately, shows up where you already are, and removes the need to re-explain yourself 50 times a day.Early traction:We’ve worked closely with 1,000+ founding members to build a product people can’t live without. GTM people at ElevenLabs, Deel, and Vercel are already using Goldfish to write faster replies in their own tone.Our founding team comes from Strawberry Browser (General Catalyst) and Depict (YC20), and we’re currently building from The Bridge by Entrepreneur First in San Francisco.Privacy:Privacy is core to the product. Your memory stays on your Mac in a local database. No cloud sync, no backend where we can browse your data, and you can stop capture of apps and domains any time. AI calls have zero data retention.Product Hunt offer:Goldfish is still in closed beta, but we’re opening early access to the Product Hunt community first.As a thank you, everyone from Product Hunt gets 3 months of free access!!
